title: Produce a complete Word-ready results table

brief.text: Run the TAM example (5,000 bootstrap draws, seed 20261103) and produce the structural results table for H1–H3 in Word, using SEM Lab's copy-to-Word action and your own edits.

checklist: A numbered title that names the model and the estimator
One row per hypothesis with its path (e.g. H1: PEOU → PU)
Standardised estimate, 95% percentile CI and p value for each path
R² (and adjusted R²) of PU and BI
A conclusion column (supported / not supported) consistent with the intervals
Consistent decimals (three) and p < .001 instead of p = .000
A note: classic PLS-SEM, path weighting, 5,000 bootstrap draws, seed 20261103, percentile CI, N = 500, abbreviations spelled out
A statement that the data are synthetic teaching data

tasks.prompt: Which items belong in the note under the table? Select all that apply.

options.text: Bootstrap draws, seed and interval type
The analyst's interpretation of why H3 is weaker than H2
options.feedback: Interpretation belongs in the text; notes describe how the numbers were produced.

tasks.prompt: The results show p = 0.000 for H1. What do you write?

options.feedback: A p value is never exactly zero.

options.text: For the endogenous constructs PU and BI, in the table or its last rows.
options.feedback: Correct. Exogenous constructs have no R².
PEOU is exogenous; nothing in the model explains it.

options.text: R² is not reported in PLS-SEM.
options.feedback: R² is a standard structural-model result in PLS-SEM.

hints: Start from the copied table and compare it with the checklist.
A reader should understand the table without the text: what would they need to know about the method?
Check every cell type: estimates, intervals, p values, R².

solution.text: A complete table lists H1–H3 with standardised estimates (PEOU → PU ≈ .498, PU → BI ≈ .501, PEOU → BI ≈ .128), 95% percentile intervals, p values (p < .001 where applicable) and a conclusion per hypothesis; R² of PU (≈ .248) and BI (≈ .331). The note states classic PLS-SEM with path weighting, 5,000 bootstrap draws, seed 20261103, percentile intervals, N = 500, abbreviations and that the data are synthetic.
